title: § 95b SGB IV — Systemprüfung (Einzelnorm, Sozialgesetzbuch Viertes Buch (IV))
issuing_body: Bundesministerium der Justiz in Verbindung mit der juris GmbH — gesetze-im-internet.de
published_or_issued_at: Artikel I des Gesetzes vom 23. Dezember 1976, BGBl. I S. 3845 (as stated on the retrieved page); current-amendment date of the retrieved § 95b wording not shown on the page and not guessed
notes: Official federal statute text (legal anchor of the Systemprüfung the prototype serves). Verified 2026-10-26 (T10-035): the norm has exactly five Absätze and prescribes NO template, form, or format for any Prüfbericht/Testbericht/Zertifikat; its only formatting duty is version-identifiability of the software (Abs. 2 sentence 4). Procedural detail (Pflichtenheft, Prüfmitteilung, SP-Richtlinien) lives in GKV-Spitzenverband/ITSG administrative rules, not in the statute. Verbatim derived text in sgb4_95b_verbatim.txt (original HTML is iso-8859-1). G0: fetch/registration is not acceptance — human owner must verify origin/version and accept before retrieval uses it.
